declarations.docstring: The square of the displayed product is a nonzero scalar multiple of that product.
Identifies the auxiliary submodule with the span of the displayed product.
A linear equivalence from the auxiliary submodule to the span generated by the displayed product.
A linear equivalence from the auxiliary submodule to the displayed-product submodule.
The submodule associated with the displayed product for the given index and partition.
Expresses the displayed-product submodule as the span of its generating product.
The module carried by the displayed-product submodule is simple.
The displayed auxiliary element does not vanish.
